extracted.intended_audience: researchers (especially early-career) who want an introduction to peer review and how to review for journals
extracted.subtask_description: An introductory training series covering why to get involved in peer review, reviewer responsibilities and ethics, transparency, diversity, and practical how-to guidance for reviewing different article types (e.g., Data Articles).

rubrics_metrics.name: The many benefits reviewing brings
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains why it is important to get involved in peer review and the benefits it can bring to reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states that carrying out peer review can sharpen your own writing skills and introduce you to movers and shakers in your field; the module 'Why get involved in peer review' (45 m) and related webinars expand on these benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Your responsibilities as a reviewer
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the duties and responsibilities that peer reviewers hold when assessing manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The introduction promises coverage of reviewer responsibilities; the collection includes a dedicated module and an 'Ethics responsibilities for peer reviewers' webinar (32 m) that the learner should consult for concrete obligations (confidentiality, impartiality, declaring conflicts, timeliness, etc.). The index page itself does not list the detailed responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics responsibilities for peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific ethical guidelines and responsibilities reviewers must comply with.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a 32-minute webinar module; the index highlights that learners will 'discover the ethics guidelines you should comply with.' The page does not reproduce the guidelines but signals this module as the source for ethical standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: A practical guide to navigating the peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step, practical guidance on how to navigate the peer review workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a 1-hour webinar (labeled 'New'); intended to teach practical aspects of reviewing, such as how to approach manuscripts and interact with editorial systems. The index is an overview and points learners to the full webinar for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: How do I review a Data Article?
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance specific to reviewing Data Articles (reviewing datasets and data-centric submissions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a 22-minute webinar in the Fundamentals series; indicates there is tailored advice for data-focused publications, but the index page contains no further specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generative AI in research evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations and guidance on the role and impact of generative AI in peer review and research evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a 1-hour webinar module; flagged as part of the fundamentals series to address emerging issues around AI use in review and evaluation. The index page does not enumerate policies or best practices directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building trust and engagement in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and practices for fostering trust and active participation among reviewers, authors, and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a 1-hour webinar; intended to cover ways to increase engagement and confidence in the peer review process. Specific techniques are contained in the webinar itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing diversity issues within the peer review system and promoting inclusive reviewer selection and practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A 1-hour webinar module that discusses diversity topics in peer review; the overview signals the theme but does not provide granular guidance on the index page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognizing peer reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: How reviewers are recognized and rewarded for their contribution to peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a 46-minute webinar titled 'Recognizing peer reviewers: A webinar to celebrate editors and researchers'; the index indicates recognition is a topic in the series (e.g., badges, acknowledgements, credit), but details are in the webinar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Rationale and practices for making peer review more transparent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A 56-minute webinar module and a theme highlighted in the series: the page explains there is a move towards transparency and that the course will explain why. Specific transparency models (open review, signed reports, published review histories) are not listed on the index page but are implied topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why get involved in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Motivations and reasons for researchers to volunteer as peer reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A 45-minute webinar included in the Fundamentals series; tied to 'The many benefits reviewing brings' and intended for learners deciding whether to start reviewing.
